{{Short description|Mexican mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=November 2022}}

{{Family name hatnote|Galeana|Sánchez|lang=Spanish}}
'''Hortensia Galeana Sánchez''' (born 6 November 1955)<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.matem.unam.mx/fsd/hgaleana/?searchterm=hortensia | title=Instituto de Matemáticas, UNAM }}</ref> is a Mexican mathematician specializing in [[graph theory]], including [[graph coloring]] and the [[Dominating set|independent dominating set]]s ("kernels") of [[directed graph]]s. She is the director of the Institute of Mathematics at the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM).{{r|dir}}

==Education and career==
Galeana is originally from Mexico City. She was educated at UNAM, earning her bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees there{{r|mem}} in 1978, 1981, and 1985 respectively.{{r|dir}} Her 1985 doctoral dissertation, ''Algunos resultados en la teoría de núcleos en digráficas'', was supervised by [[Víctor Neumann-Lara]].{{r|mg}}

She has taught at UNAM since 1977 and was named director of the UNAM Institute of Mathematics in 2022.{{r|dir}}

==Recognition==
Galeana is a member of the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]].{{r|amc}} In 1995 and again in 2015 UNAM gave her their National University Prize.{{r|pun|mem}}
